mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart to the blood-filled circuit brought the separate pieces together and made the return path clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining red blood cells with plasma was predictable and offered little explanation beyond identifying the other blood components.

surprise.text: I was interested that red blood cells make ATP from sugar despite having no mitochondria or nucleus; the pathway itself was only briefly explained.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, although the dots crossing the capillary wall were not identified, which made the exchange less clear.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: building the circuit was satisfying, and I am curious how it will connect to other body systems.
